# LSM Tree Indexing in Apache Iceberg — CS631 Project

Team: Shiv Narang (23b1075), Kaushal Vijayvergiya (23b0901), Kritin Gupta (23b0948)

* **`final_report.pdf`**: final report (HTML source `final_report.html`, generated by
  `lsm-iceberg-java/report/make_report.py` from `lsm-iceberg-java/results/*.json`)
* **`lsm-iceberg-java/`**: the implementation (Java 17, Apache Iceberg 1.10, Avro runs, Puffin key index,
  leveled compaction, Iceberg baselines, YCSB evaluation). See its README.
  Quick start: `cd lsm-iceberg-java && ./run.sh test && ./run.sh demo`
* `lsm-iceberg-java/spark/`: Spark 3.5 job that queries the LSM-Iceberg table (`./run.sh usecase && ./run.sh spark`)
* `checkpoint_report.pdf`: checkpoint printout (HTML source: `checkpoint_report.html`)
* `readme.txt`: original project proposal
* `lsm_iceberg/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`: early Python/PyIceberg prototype (checkpoint only)

Rebuild the report PDF after `./run.sh eval`, `./run.sh usecase` and `./run.sh spark`:

```bash
python3 lsm-iceberg-java/report/make_report.py
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless=new --no-pdf-header-footer \
  --print-to-pdf="$PWD/final_report.pdf" "file://$PWD/final_report.html"
```
